description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy (%) of four different video understanding models as a function of the number of frames, ranging from 10 to 60 on a linear scale. The y-axis represents accuracy in percentage, scaled linearly from 40% to 54%. The blue line with circular markers, labeled "Ours (Dynamic Seg)", begins at approximately 53% at 10 frames and rises slightly to about 54% at 20 frames before leveling off. The green line with circular markers, labeled "Ours (Static 4-Seg)", starts at approximately 52.5% at 10 frames, rises to about 53.5% at 20 frames, and then remains nearly flat at approximately 53.8% through 60 frames. The orange line with square markers, labeled "PLLaVA (DP 8)", begins at approximately 45% at 10 frames and steadily declines to about 39.5% at 60 frames. The red line with square markers, labeled "PLLaVA (DP 16)", starts at approximately 45.5% at 10 frames, declines to about 43.5% at 20 frames, continues to decrease to approximately 42.5% at 30 frames, and further drops to about 42% at 60 frames.
